rows.label: bf07200100_0010
rows.name:
To think he's fine even with part of his core
missing...

rows.label: bf07200100_0020
rows.name:
Isn't there something
strange about his body?

rows.label: bf07200100_0030
rows.name:
That's because Heaven's Holy Grail
'Metsu' is the Master Blade.

rows.label: bf07200100_0040
rows.name: The first Blade created by God.

rows.label: bf07200100_0050
rows.name: Unlike us, he can do pretty much anything.

rows.label: bf07200100_0060
rows.name:
And? How's he going to
restore his core exactly?

rows.label: bf07200100_0070
rows.name:
He'll take the missing data from Heaven's
Holy Grail's core and regain his power.

rows.label: bf07200100_0080
rows.name: Mhmm. Okay. So what will that do to her?

rows.label: bf07200100_0090
rows.name:
Naturally, her personality would be torn to shreds.
At best, she'd be left a wreck.

rows.label: bf07200100_0100
rows.name:
That's vicious... He really
has a terrible personality.
